## 9.1 Account

### Gaps (the FSD says it, the code doesn't do it)

- **F-061** The Account page has no two-factor authentication option; only username, email, password, OIDC unlink and age restriction. _(found by every run)_
  - FSD: “Users can turn on two-factor sign-in with an authenticator app.”
  - Code: `UI/Web/src/app/user-settings/account-settings/account-settings.component.html:3`, `UI/Web/src/app/user-settings`

### Conflicts (the code does it differently)

- **F-062** The server requires a minimum password length of 6 (validation text: between 6 and 256 characters). _(found by every run)_
  - FSD: “A new password must be at least 8 characters long.”
  - Code: `Kavita.Server/Extensions/IdentityServiceExtensions.cs:59`, `UI/Web/src/assets/langs/en.json:4939`
- **F-063** Only the new password and confirmation are required fields; the old password is not required (it is only compared with the confirmation by a validator). Read Only users are also excluded. _(found by run 2)_
  - FSD: “Changing the password requires the current password and is only open to administrators and users with the Change Password role.”
  - Code: `UI/Web/src/app/user-settings/change-password/change-password.component.ts:36`, `UI/Web/src/app/user-settings/change-password/change-password.component.ts:46`
